nonnegotiable_completion_rule: A language or repository is not complete until its source/license boundary, complete semantic extraction report, local materialization receipt, AArch64 Android target probe, integrity recovery receipt, and NSQ interception route all pass.

gaps.exact_action: Materialize the pinned Rust source via the explicit source-edge lane, record SHA-256 and license evidence, then run stage1 and stage2 source builds on the target.
Materialize the pinned CPython source via the explicit source-edge lane, record SHA-256 and license evidence, then run the Android source build and native extension probe.
Acquire a matching pinned source archive with checksum and license record, build it only after stage2 succeeds, and prove Android equivalence before activation.
Run scripts/braxon_reconstruct.sh preflight and provide at least BRAXON_MIN_BUILD_FREE_KIB on an executable non-shared-storage path before starting any full source build.
Run the approved source build against the retained LLVM content identity and retain C/C++ compile, link, ELF, DWARF, and AArch64 Android target execution receipts.
Run scripts/toolchains/unified_android_libc_contract_overlay.sh on the target and retain header, library, exported-symbol, and target-run proof artifacts.

For every applicable language surface, generate content-addressed identity, grammar, AST, type, control/data-flow, IR, diagnostics, ABI, assembly, object, debug, linking, target, materialization, and recovery proofs under state/nsq/semantic_extraction/<language>/; the exact missing files are returned by cargo run --locked --offline -- language <language> <input>.

gaps.scope: intercept wrappers, hash manifest, package guard, and recovery overlay
gaps.exact_action: After the source-built tool lanes exist, run scripts/braxon_reconstruct.sh calibrate on native Android AArch64 Termux, source the generated profile fragment, and retain a passing calibration hash verification.

Acquire each pinned source edge without executing it, apply the manifest’s license decision, remove/quarantine credentials, obtain necessary authorization, then create an approved source-only Android build contract and target receipt. PAPI remains legally blocked unless P.A.P.I. Labs gives written authorization.

gaps.scope: restricted or unlicensed source edges requiring a lawful original replacement
gaps.exact_action: Create independent public-behavior specifications and provenance review before writing any clean-room Android-native replacement; do not derive implementation from restricted source.
After all prior gaps close, run scripts/braxon_closure_gate.sh on an isolated writable target checkout and retain a fully passing truth table.
